description: The von Staudt denominator of B(m) for even m at least 2: the product of primes p such that p-1 divides m. The denominator of B2 is 6, and of B4 is 30. An odd m is rejected. m runs from 2 to 40. Returns JSON with: m, primes, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bernoulli-denom
